meta.title: Optimize Docker build time with improved Dockerfiles and .dockerignore files
meta.body_summary: Optimize Docker build process by adding .dockerignore files, consolidating RUN commands, using npm ci, and adding --no-install-recommends apt flag.

core_change_summary.description: Added .dockerignore files for browser and python Docker contexts to exclude unnecessary files; consolidated RUN commands and switched to npm ci in browser Dockerfile; added --no-install-recommends to apt-get in python Dockerfile.
